tools.name: delegate_task
tools.description: Delegate ONE self-contained subtask to a fresh child agent with its own forked context (inherits settings/memory snapshot). You continue working after it returns. Delegated tasks CANNOT delegate further (one level only). The child does NOT see your conversation; pass everything it needs in 'task'/'context'.

context.description: Optional extra context/data for the child

tools.name: list_delegations
tools.description: List your delegated tasks and their status/results.
